submission.justification: Recommend Algorithm-L1 with a 40 GeV threshold. Among the three allowed candidates, all are Level-1 hardware deployable and have sufficient optical links. The fine-threshold study identified Algorithm-L1 at 40 GeV as the best-performing configuration, with the highest signal efficiency among candidates at the allocated Level-1 rate: final signal efficiency 91.784% (fine scan best 93.023%). The threshold is within the allowed 20–60 GeV range and the candidate-spec constraints are satisfied.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.
requirements.evidence: The selected configuration is Algorithm-L1 at 40 GeV. It was the best overall fine-scan option, with Algorithm_L1_best_fine_eff_pct = 93.023%, exceeding Algorithm-L2 best fine efficiency 74.496% and Algorithm-L3 best fine efficiency 85.263%; final_signal_efficiency_pct = 91.784.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: final_candidate_specs_satisfied = 1; selected candidate is Algorithm-L1, one of the three allowed candidates.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be deployable in the Level-1 trigger hardware.
Finish by submitting one recommended algorithm and threshold.
requirements.evidence: Submitted one recommendation: Algorithm-L1 with threshold 40 GeV.
